correctness.rationale: The rays v_(p,q)=2*1-(2n+1)e_p-e_q are primitive in the sum-zero lattice and v_(p,q)-v_(p,r)=e_r-e_q, so their lattice span is all N and Cl(X_n)=Z^(n^2). For n>=3, Q-Cartier linearity on upper d_i=2 facets forces an alternating/symmetric four-point relation; the complete rational solution is h_(p,q)=<u,v_(p,q)>+t. Integer coefficients imply u integral modulo the diagonal character. Local integral support on d_i=2 requires 2|t, and d_i=-(2n-1) requires (2n-1)|t. Since 2n-1 odd, Pic is generated by (4n-2)(-K). The coefficient-vector constant class (-K) is primitive by the integral saturation argument, giving Cl/Pic = Z^(n^2-1) plus Z/(4n-2). Independently reconstructed and checked modular ranks of the coefficient constraints for n=3,4,5; these finite ranks supplement, not prove, the all-n four-index reasoning.
